name: Rock+
description: Entry-level shoe with a neutral flat profile, low asymmetry and spacious high-volume fit; two rip-tab straps, synthetic polyamide/PU upper and Vibram XS Grip rubber.

name: Cliff
description: Slipper-style shoe with a single Velcro strap and elasticated inserts; leather upper and flat, straight last aimed at beginners for indoor climbing, cragging and bouldering.

name: Edge
description: Performance shoe with a downturned, highly asymmetric last and heel tension; slipper design with a single Velcro strap, stretchy microfiber upper and 4 mm Vibram XS Grip sole.

name: Rock
description: Beginner lace-up shoe with a flat last and a midsole covering the front of the foot for edge precision; cotton upper, suited to indoor, sport, bouldering and multi-pitch climbing.

name: Vertika
description: Technical progression shoe with a slightly asymmetric pointed shape, moderate heel tension and a supportive midsole; two rip-tab straps, Lorica/leather upper and 4 mm Vibram XS Grip sole.

officialSpecs.upper: Lorica synthetic leather forefoot, split leather upper
officialSpecs.midsole: Reinforced midsole for support and power
